title: Took my first crack at vibe coding. Would love any feedback on my Cabaret Management sim.
author: SpicyBoyEnthusiast
selftext:
I took my first crack at creating a game with the use of AI. I stepped out of my comfort zone and went straight for a sim. I typically create retro arcade-style games.   
[https://wavedash.com/games/cabaret-manager](https://wavedash.com/games/cabaret-manager)  
  
If you've played Yakuza you'll recognize this Cabaret Manager I created.   
  
I used Codex, Blender and some graphic sets I found on Itch.io.   
  
I think the game is kinda fun, but iI feel like it lacks soul or something. It doesn't have what made the similar mini-game in Yakuza fun. I'm not sure what it's missing. Any feedback would be appreciated.

replies.author: SpicyBoyEnthusiast
replies.body: Thank you so much for the great feedback! I really appreciate it.
